title: parse_state_data clones serde_json::Value before deserializing changed field
description: sse.rs parse_state_data calls serde_json::from_value::<...>(changed_val.clone()) — the .clone() is unnecessary because from_value consumes its argument and the original val is not needed afterward. Restructuring to remove the clone (e.g. extracting changed before the match, or using a single serde_json::from_value call on val directly) would avoid one full serde_json::Value clone per StateChange received.
